summary: This video tests the new Season 9 Radiant Aura hero Holfast at Inspiration 0 in Temporal Vortex IV Cloudtop Arbor (Sunlit side). Holfast acts as a support and sub-DPS by providing Aura energy to the highest-attack ally, granting a 30% damage bonus upon ally ultimate cast, and providing random offensive buffs. Deployed alongside Talethia, Diantha, Anneliesis, and Celestine, the Aura team achieved 11.7 billion damage, with Holfast contributing 1.48 billion (12.7%) and Talethia doing the bulk (80%). Full hero builds and exact skill timings are provided.
